message.content: Confirmed the fuzzer failure — starting triage by shrinking to a minimal reproduction.
Shrink isolated a 3-body case failing momentum at step 5. Replaying and inspecting the trajectory to diagnose the cause.
Momentum starts drifting at step 4 as bodies converge. I'll verify the full violation pattern and test a fix.
Analysis shows close approach drives integration error that breaks momentum conservation. Testing a counterfactual with smaller time step.
Verified that higher resolution fixes the drift, confirming the root cause. Finalizing the failure report.
